greeting: Egameni likaYise, nelikaNyana, nelikaMoya Oyingcwele. Makube noxolo lweNkosi yethu uYesu Kristu kuni nonke.
penitential:
Nkosi, ube nenceba kuthi.
Kristu, ube nenceba kuthi.
Nkosi, ube nenceba kuthi.
homily:
Kukho imifanekiso ethile ebomini bethu ehlala imi njengemililo emincinci ebumnyameni, isikhumbuza ukuba kukho ukukhanya okungaphezu kokuba amehlo ethu angabona. Cinga ngelo xesha xa umntu oselula, oselula kakhulu, ejonga ikamva lakhe engaboni nje imida yeli hlabathi, kodwa ebona amathuba angapheliyo. UBenjamin Vo wayengumfana owayenalo olo hlobo lokukhanya. Wayengumfana owayezazi kakuhle izibalo, owayekwazi ukucinga nge-AI kunye ne-cloud infrastructure ngendlela eyayimangalisa abantu abadala, kodwa ngaphezu kwako konke, wayephethe isibane sothando esasingacimi. Khumbula indlela awayethanda ngayo ukujonga iinqwelo-moya, indlela awayehlekisa ngayo ngala mava e-'con chim airlines' awayeyila entloko yakhe. Wayengumfana owayephila ngoncumo, owayezimisele ukunika konke okwakhe, kanye njengaloo mzuzu xa wayefuna ukunikela ngemali yakhe yasebhange ukunceda umalume wakhe uWilliam. Akazange ayiphule loo ngulube, kodwa isipho sasingaphakathi entliziyweni yakhe—isipho sokuzinikela okungenamkhawulo.

KwiNcwadi kaPawulos kwabaseFilipi namhlanje, uPawulos usixelela into enzulu kakhulu: 'Work out your salvation with fear and trembling. For God is the one who, for his good purpose, works in you both to desire and to work.' Masiyimele kancinci le ndinyana… UPawulos akathethi ngomsebenzi onzima esiwenzayo ukuze sifumane uthando lukaThixo. Uthetha ngento eyahlukileyo. Uthetha ngentsebenziswano phakathi kwethu noThixo. UThixo uyasebenza kuthi, uyasityhala, uyasinika amandla, kodwa thina kufuneka sivume. UBen wayengumntwana owavuma. Wayengumntwana owavumela uThixo ukuba asebenze kuye, ngokuba ngumntwana owayekhathalela abanye, owayehlonipha abazali bakhe, kwaye owayengoyiki ukuzama izinto ezintsha. UBen wayengumntwana owawuqonda umthwalo wokuba ngumKristu, kodwa wayewuthwala ngoncumo nangobubele.

Kodwa, masithethe inyaniso namhlanje. Ukuthwala umnqamlezo, njengoko uYesu esitsho kwiVangeli, akulula. 'Whoever does not carry his own cross and come after me cannot be my disciple.' Le yintetho enzima. UYesu akathethi ngomnqweno; uthetha ngobomi. Alan noThao, nawe Ryan mfowethu omncane, ndiyazi ukuba kule minyane minne idlulileyo ukususela ngowe-13 kuJuni 2026, iintlungu ziza ngamanye amaxesha ngendlela embi kakhulu, zikushiya ungazi nokuba ume ngaphi. Kukho amandla emphefumlo aphelileyo, kukho ubusuku obude lapho ukungabikho kwesitulo sikaBen okanye ukungaphulaphuli kwakhe amabanga ayethethwa nguyise kubangela isikhewu esingazalisekiyo. Kukho amaxesha apho ukuziva usodwa kuhlasela ngaphandle kwesaziso, kwaye umthwalo wokulahlekelwa uba nzima kakhulu ukuba ungathwalwa.

Mamela le nyaniso namhlanje, mhlawumbi ngendlela odinga ngayo ukuyiva ngoku: uThixo akamlibalanga uBen, kwaye akakubalelanga nani. Kwizinto ezenzekayo ebudeni bokugula kwabantwana, abazali abaninzi bazithwala ngokwabo umthwalo onzima kakhulu wokuzisola: 'Ngaba kukhona endinokukwenza ngcono? Ngaba ndiphosile?' Mamele kakuhle, Alan noThao: uThixo akakubeki icala. UBen akakubeki icala. Ezo zifo aziziswanga zizinto owazenzayo okanye ongazenzanga. Kweli hlabathi, kukho izinto ezenzeka ngaphandle kolawulo lomntu, ngaphandle kwempazamo yomzali. Awuphosanga nto. Uthando lwakho lwalucocekile, lwaluphelele, kwaye uBen wayesazi ukuba unothando olungaka kubazali bakhe nakuRyan. Khipha elo litye lokuzisola ezintliziyweni zenu namhlanje. UBen akajongi iziphoso; ujonge phezulu kuThixo, kwaye uqhubeka esithi kuwe: 'Ba, Mama, musani ukukhala kakhulu, ndikhuselekile.'

KwiVangeli, uYesu uthetha ngendoda eyakha inqaba. Uthi kufuneka uqale ubala iindleko. UBen, ngobukrelekrele bakhe, wayeyazi le nto. Wayeyazi ukuba ukwakha ikamva kufuna ukuzimisela. Kodwa uYesu akathethi nje ngesakhiwo esenziwe ngamatye. Uthetha ngesakhiwo somphefumlo. UBen wayesakha inqaba yothando, inqaba yokholo, inqaba eyayiza kuhlala ngonaphakade. UBen akazange azame ukwakha inqaba yezinto zeli hlabathi kuphela; wayesakha inqaba yobuhlobo noThixo. Kwaye leyo inqaba ayizange iwe. Isekhona, iqinile, kwaye ikhanya ngaphambi kobuso bukaThixo.

Ryan, mfowethu okhoyo apha, ndifuna uthathe oku nawe. UBen akakushiye. Ukhona ecaleni kwakho, eqhubeka ekusebenza njengesikhokelo sothando. UBen wayengumfana owayenenqgondo enkulu yezibalo, kodwa ikratshi lakhe elikhulu kwakuwukuba ngumntwana omhle owayehlonipha abazali bakhe. UBen uya kuhlala ekukhuthaza, nangona ungamboni ngamehlo, kodwa uya kumva entliziyweni yakho. Uthando lwenu njengabazalwana luyinto engunaphakade. Xa uziva usodwa, khumbula ukuba uBen ukhona, uyaqhubeka, kwaye uya kuhlala ephila kuthando lukaThixo olungapheliyo.

Masithathe oku namhlanje: uBen wasishiya isipho sothando olungapheliyo. Kwisikhumbuzo sesidlo sasezulwini, lapho indlu kaThixo izele khona ngabantu abavela kude nakufi, masime nathi namhlanje siqinisekile ukuba ubomi bukaBen abuphelanga ethuneni. Usemthekweni wasezulwini, apho i-'con chim airlines' yakhe ibhabha ngokuphakamileyo phambi kobuso bukaThixo. Hamba ke namhlanje uphumle, uthembe ukuba uThixo uyakuthanda, kwaye uBen ulinda wena ngoncumo lwakhe oluqhelekileyo. UBen akakho nje kwimbali yenu; ukwikhona apho uThixo enza khona yonke into ibe ntsha. Uthando lwakho, Ben, lusaqhubeka luhamba emhlabeni, lusaqhubeka lukhanya, kwaye lusaqhubeka lukhumbuza wonke umntu okwaziyo ukuba uThixo uyamthanda umntwana wakhe ngaphezu kwayo yonke into. Hlalani neli themba. Hlalani nolu thando. UBen ukhona, uyaqhubeka, kwaye uya kuhlala ephila kuthando lukaThixo olungapheliyo. Amen.
spiritual_communion: Nkosi yam uYesu, ndiyakholwa ukuba ukhona ngenene kule Sakramente. Ndiyakuthanda ngaphezu kwako konke, kwaye ndinqwenela ukukwamkela emphefumlweni wam. Njengoko ndingenako ngoku ukukwamkela ngokwenyama, nceda uze emphefumlweni wam ngomoya. Ndiyakwamkela njengokuba sele ukhona, kwaye ndizimanya nawe ngokupheleleyo. Ungaze undivumele ndahluke kuwe. Amen.
closing: Makube nani uxolo lukaThixo, olugqithise konke ukuqonda, ngoku naphakade. Amen.
standing_petitions: Sithandazela umphefumlo kaBenjamin Vo nabo bonke abasishiyileyo, ukuze baphumle ekukhanyeni kukaKristu ngonaphakade.
Sithandazela bonke abalilayo nabo baphethe imithwalo enzima, ukuze uThixo abathuthuzele anike ithemba elingenakuphela.

readings.label: Isifundo sokuqala
readings.text: Abathandekayo bam, njengoko nihlala nithobela, kungekuphela nje xa ndikhona, kodwa ngakumbi ngoku xa ndingekho, sebenzani usindiso lwenu ngokoyika nangokungcangcazela. Kuba nguThixo osebenza kuni, ngenjongo yakhe elungileyo, ukuba nibe nomnqweno nokusebenza. Yenzani yonke into ngaphandle kokukhalaza okanye ukubuza, ukuze nibe ngabangenacala nabamsulwa, abantwana bakaThixo abangenabala phakathi kwesizukulwana esigwenxekileyo nesonakeleyo, phakathi kwabo nikhanya njengezibane ehlabathini, njengoko nibambelele elizwini lobomi, ukuze ukuqhayisa kwam ngemini kaKristu kube kukuba andibalekanga ize, andisebenzanga ize. Kodwa, naxa ndithululwa njengomnikelo phezu kwenkonzo yomnikelo wokholo lwenu, ndiyavuya kwaye ndabelana ngovuyo lwam nani nonke. Ngendlela efanayo nani nani nifanele nivuye nabelane ngovuyo lwenu nam.

readings.label: INdumiso
readings.text: R. INkosi ilukhanyiso lwam nosindiso lwam. INkosi ilukhanyiso lwam nosindiso lwam; ndiya koyika bani na? INkosi iyinqaba yobomi bam; ndiya kunkwantya bani na? R. INkosi ilukhanyiso lwam nosindiso lwam. Into enye endiyicelayo eNkosini; ndiyifunayo yile: Ukuhlala endlwini yeNkosi yonke imihla yobomi bam, ukuze ndikwazi ukubona ubuhle beNkosi, ndicamngce ngetempile yayo. R. INkosi ilukhanyiso lwam nosindiso lwam. Ndiyakholwa ukuba ndiya kubona ububele beNkosi ezweni labaphilayo. Lindela iNkosi ngesibindi; yomelela, ulindele iNkosi. R. INkosi ilukhanyiso lwam nosindiso lwam.

readings.label: IVangeli
readings.text: Izihlwele ezikhulu zazihamba noYesu, wajika wazithetha kuzo, 'Ukuba umntu uza kum engazange azide uyise nonina, umfazi nabantwana, abazalwana noodade, kwanobomi bakhe, akanakuba ngumfundi wam. Lowo ungathwaliyo umnqamlezo wakhe eze emva kwam akanakuba ngumfundi wam. Ngubani kuni onqwenela ukwakha inqaba ongahlali phantsi kuqala abale iindleko ukubona ukuba kukho okwaneleyo ukuyigqiba? Kungenjalo, emva kokubeka isiseko nokufumanisa engakwazi ukugqiba umsebenzi, ababukeli bangahleka kuye bathi, "Lo waqala ukwakha kodwa wayengenazo izixhobo zokugqiba." Okanye yeyiphi inkosi ehamba iye emfazweni engahlali phantsi kuqala igqibe ukuba ngamajoni alishumi elinewaka ingaphumelela ukumelana nenye inkosi ehamba nezinye ezingamashumi amabini anewaka? Kodwa ukuba akunjalo, ngeli lixa isekude, iya kuthumela abathunywa ukuba bacele uxolo. Ngendlela efanayo, wonke umntu kuni ongashiyiyo zonke izinto zakhe akanakuba ngumfundi wam.'

day: Memorial of Saint Charles Borromeo, Bishop

pet_prayers.text: Thinking of you buddy! Stop by to say hello whenever you can okay? Love you Ben

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben - Been dreaming about you a lot. Hope you're having fun up in heaven. Please look after our family. Remember to come say hi daily. We miss you so much!

Ben ơi, trong giấc ngủ anh Huy đã thấy Ben về thăm anh, trao cho anh lời cầu nguyện để hai anh em mình lại được tìm thấy nhau. Xin Chúa thương nhậm lời Ben, cho Ben được hưởng ngàn thu bình an bên Chúa. Nếu có thể, xin Ben lại ghé thăm anh trong những giấc mơ tiếp theo nhé, dù chỉ là một lời chào hay một nụ cười thân thương như ngày nào.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Ben, my sweet boy, I miss you so much. Thank you for visiting me and Chú Chris last night. He told me he saw you flying a helicopter—so free, joyful, and strong up there. Down here, Mom and I are crying more and more each day. A piece of my heart feels completely dead without you, Ben. Please watch over us, pray for your mom, your brother Ryan, and me, and give us the strength to keep going. We love you forever

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Today marks 100 days without you. Miss you a whole a lot Ben. Feel free to visit any time! See you around buddy! Love you!

Ben ơi, nay anh M đi xử lý hồ sơ ở Cam Ranh, đi ngang qua Cam Ranh Airport. Rồi cuộc nói chuyện về máy bay của Ben lại ùa về, nhớ nhiều kỷ niệm về Ben lắm ( anh M sẽ giữ kín kakaka). Quỷ nhỏ, tự nhiên nghĩ về mày buồn dễ sợ. Hãy đi đến những nơi mà Ben muốn nha và đừng quên là luôn nhớ về gia đình mình nhé, thương em trai nhiều. Giá như !!!!!!!!!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: What happened my son? It's been 3 months since you left us. Missing you so much my whole body aches. Mom cries every day now... What are we going to do now Ben?  Please pray for us.
